## Description

The conventional name is `'INCH'`; producers sometimes write `'inch'`, `'IN'`, or `'inches'` on the `name` attribute of `CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT`, breaking case-sensitive lookup tables.

## Reproducer recipe

`CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT('inches', #lmwu)`.

## Expected kernel behavior

warn; case-insensitive match against the canonical set `{INCH, FOOT, MILLIMETRE, MILLIMETER, METER, METRE, MIL, MICROINCH}`; resolve via `dimensional_exponents` rather than `name` text.
